## Description

Linear algebra helpers in R [@RCoreTeam-2026]:
vectorization and half-vectorization,
symmetric matrices from their half-vectorization,
the duplication matrix and its Moore-Penrose inverse,
deviation scores,
and tests for symmetric and positive definite matrices.
Each exported function has an internal version without input checks
that other projects can copy.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `linearAlgebra` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/linearAlgebra) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/linearAlgebra")
```

## Example

```{r}
library(package = "linearAlgebra")
```

A covariance matrix of three variables.

```{r}
sigma <- stats::cov(x = datasets::mtcars[, c("mpg", "wt", "hp")])
sigma
```

`Vec()` stacks the columns.
`Vech()` stacks the lower triangle with the diagonal,
and `Vechs()` the lower triangle without it.

```{r}
Vec(x = sigma)
Vech(x = sigma)
Vechs(x = sigma)
```

`SymofVech()` and `SymofVechs()` rebuild the symmetric matrix.

```{r}
SymofVech(x = Vech(x = sigma))
SymofVechs(x = Vechs(x = sigma), diags = diag(x = sigma))
```

The duplication matrix maps the half-vectorization to the vectorization,
and its Moore-Penrose inverse maps back.

```{r}
d_mat <- DMat(k = 3)
all.equal(
  target = as.vector(x = d_mat %*% Vech(x = sigma)),
  current = Vec(x = sigma)
)
all.equal(
  target = as.vector(x = PInvDmat(k = 3) %*% Vec(x = sigma)),
  current = unname(obj = Vech(x = sigma))
)
```

Tests for symmetric and positive definite matrices.

```{r}
TestSymmetric(x = sigma)
TestPositiveDefinite(x = sigma)
```

Deviation scores.

```{r}
deviation <- Deviation(
  x = as.matrix(x = datasets::mtcars[, c("mpg", "wt")])
)
utils::head(x = deviation)
```
